url_rules: Serbian Latin, lowercase, ASCII slugs without diacritics, hyphen-separated, stable canonical URLs.
canonical_strategy: One canonical URL per article; noindex drafts/review pages; parameter URLs canonicalize to clean paths.
hreflang_strategy: Add sr-RS first; add sr-BA, sr-ME, hr-HR, mk-MK only after localized content exists.
